tips.text: Grab all 3 Sister Beacons every run to summon the Sister; she adds about 40 to 50 percent more motes.
Run Ascension on Steel Path once you have it; it adds motes without making the mission longer.
Throw boosted charges as soon as you find them and keep plain ones for when the power meter runs low.
Run Ascension solo or in a premade squad; public players often kill enemies and never throw charges.
Skip Resource Boosters, Desecrate and Resourceful Retriever; they do not raise Vestigial Mote drops.
In a squad, keep one player on the elevator throwing while the others fetch boosted charges and drop them on the platform.
Use a mobile or stealth frame such as Zephyr, Titania, Wukong or Ivara to collect charges and beacons.
Expect a slow, timer-bound farm rather than a hard one; most players rate it easier than recent frame farms.
